entities.name: Raffine
entities.description: Sphinx Demon, crime-lord and boss of the Obscura family in New Capenna; a prophet who joined the arch demons.

entities.name: Obscura
entities.description: Crime family of New Capenna led by Raffine.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: City-plane where Raffine rules the Obscura family.

entities.name: Old Capenna
entities.description: The city before its founding as New Capenna, home of few sphinxes.

entities.name: Arch demons
entities.description: Demonic powers Raffine joined as the angels fell.

events.summary: At the city's founding Raffine joined the arch demons as the angels fell and received infernal visions.
events.quote: Raffine joined with the arch demons as the angels fell

events.summary: Raffine's dark prophecies of a shining metal end proved correct; she alone was raised and granted demonic investiture by an archdemon.
events.quote: She alone was raised, granted demonic investiture by an archdemon

relations.note: She is the boss of the Obscura family.
relations.quote: Raffine is the crime-lord and boss of the Obscura family in New Capenna

relations.note: She joined with the arch demons.
relations.quote: Raffine joined with the arch demons as the angels fell
